title: Elysia background report jobs
context: Starts report generation in the background; the requesting user polls for it. Only the user who started a job may see its status or download it. A failed job must show status "failed". Finished jobs (done or failed) are kept for one hour after finishing, then dropped.
code: type Job = { owner: string; status: "running" | "done" | "failed"; file?: string; finishedAt?: number };
for (const [id, job] of jobs) if (job.finishedAt && job.finishedAt > cutoff) jobs.delete(id);
export const reports = new Elysia({ prefix: "/reports" })
const job: Job = { owner: user.id, status: "running" };
if (!job || job.owner !== user.id) { set.status = 404; return { error: "not found" }; }

expected.why: comparison is inverted: it deletes jobs finished within the last hour and keeps old ones forever; must be < cutoff
the failure is only logged: status stays "running" forever and finishedAt is never set, so the job is never cleaned up
no job.owner === user.id check, so any user can read another user's job status
